title: ULtimate BodyBuilding™
author: Jack PG
desc:
Bodybuilding has always been a passion of mine. Through my thorough time lifting and progressively learning, overloading and trying new things, has culminated to this program. It is to cater to my personal taste in rep ranges, exercises, movement patterns etc. 
While also doing the appropriate volume, intensity, and frequency to get the best of bodybuilding that my knowledge can create. Focus, Lift hard, Get PRs every session, You can do this.


Program has double progression for progressive overload, for example:


Week 1: 3 sets of 7 reps with 200Lbs(6-8 rep range)

Week 2: 3 sets of 8 reps with 200Lbs (6-8 rep range)

Week 3: 3 sets of 6 reps with 205Lbs (6-8 rep range)


Most sets should be done with the following tempo

Concentric: Doesn't matter, speed can change as set goes on

Eccentric: ≈2-3 seconds, shorter eccentric for less range of motion movements and opposite for longer range of motion movements

Pause: pause on some movements based on whether or not it will improve the form of the exercise


Count reps properly, Do sets intensely, Prioritize proper technique, Add weight when you can
